scientific_review: Internal pass checked receptor mechanics, Ia/II distinctions, gamma actions, Piezo2, stretch/reciprocal and Ib pathways, context-dependent Ib facilitation, H/M interpretation, passive/active tone and descending regulation. Corrected gamma feedback routing, stimulus diagrams and timing proportions. Recomputed numerical answers: 6, 5, 46, 3, 2000, 6, 30, 40, 34, 24, 0.5, 0.3, 4.5, 50 in their respective stated units; all 52 keys match options and explanatory reasoning. Hypothetical numerical values and graph traces are distinguished from published data.
editorial_review: Separate internal pass checked 15-section progressive sequence, beginner definitions, paragraph distinctness, diagram titles and captions, exam boundaries, misconception correction, recap, active recall and mastery. Refined graph-linked questions, repaired SVG attributes, improved labels and caption sequence; retained reader template and dynamic adjacent-node navigation.
